description: a ball of radius 2 cut flat at z = ±1.5 (a revolved arc, so no pole) and a cylinder of radius 0.6 along +x with its axis at (0, 0, 0.5), fused, the edge where the cylinder leaves the ball filleted at r 0.1 at a point 60° round from the cylinder's top: a sphere against a cylinder off its axis, a quartic meeting no closed form of the table (ADR-0036's sphere rows are coaxial). The loop is two arcs at two vertices, on the ball's seam in the plane y = 0 where the loop crosses it square, each a walked stripe (ADR-0062) meeting the other on the ball's arc there (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 9). Open CASCADE builds it as a walked B-spline too, whose ball misses the cylinder and the sphere by 8.6e-6 at the median of 3042 samples of its blend and 4.1e-5 at worst; over the blend's area that is the 5.3e-8 relative its volume lies from Arris' and the 2.7e-7 its area does. The measure tolerances cover that miss, under ADR-0062's 1e-5 for a walked fixture (no closed form holds the blend). A crossing of the ball's seam that is not square is refused (docs/BACKLOG.md)
